input.description: Find hooks files with memo CRUD patterns

content.text:
Here are my findings:

---

## Primary File: Memo CRUD Mutations and Queries

**`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`** is the main module containing memo CRUD mutations and queries.

### Exported hooks (queries):

| Hook | Type | Service call |
|---|---|---|
| `useMemos` | `useQuery` | `memoServiceClient.listMemos(...)` |
| `useInfiniteMemos` | `useInfiniteQuery` | `memoServiceClient.listMemos(...)` (paginated) |
| `useMemo` | `useQuery` | `memoServiceClient.getMemo({ name })` |
| `useLinkMetadata` | `useQuery` | `memoServiceClient.getLinkMetadata({ url })` |
| `useMemoComments` | `useQuery` | `memoServiceClient.listMemoComments(...)` |
| `useInfiniteMemoComments` | `useInfiniteQuery` | `memoServiceClient.listMemoComments(...)` (paginated) |

### Exported hooks (mutations):

| Hook | Type | Service call |
|---|---|---|
| `useCreateMemo` | `useMutation` | `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo })` |
| `useUpdateMemo` | `useMutation` | `memoServiceClient.updateMemo({ memo, updateMask })` (with optimistic updates and rollback) |
| `useDeleteMemo` | `useMutation` | `memoServiceClient.deleteMemo({ name })` |

### Cache key factory:

The file also exports `memoKeys` -- a query-key factory object with keys for `all`, `lists`, `list`, `details`, `detail`, `comments`, and `linkMetadata`.

---

## Secondary File: Memo Share Queries

**`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoShareQueries.ts`** contains share-link-related CRUD operations, also using `memoServiceClient`:

- `useMemoShares` (query) -- `memoServiceClient.listMemoShares`
- `useCreateMemoShare` (mutation) -- `memoServiceClient.createMemoShare`
- `useDeleteMemoShare` (mutation) -- `memoServiceClient.deleteMemoShare`
- `useSharedMemo` (query) -- `memoServiceClient.getMemoByShare`

---

## Generated Service Client

All hooks use **`memoServiceClient`**, which is created in **`/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`** at line 197:

```typescript
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```

This uses `createClient` from `@connectrpc/connect` with the `MemoService` descriptor imported from the generated protobuf file at:

**`/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`**

The transport is a Connect-Web transport (`@connectrpc/connect-web`) configured with binary format and an authentication interceptor that handles token refresh and retry on 401.
